bias.en: Bearish · gapped down, near the $270.7 52-week low
bias.zh: 看空 · 跳空下跌，逼近 52 周低点 $270.7

read.en: Alphabet gapped down 12.6% on Oct 29 to $283.82 and slipped 1.4% on Oct 30 to $279.84, trading between $276.92 and $283.14 on 2.1 times average volume. It is below the falling 5-day ($305.2), 10-day ($319.0), 30-day ($337.3), 100-day ($345.5) and 200-day ($340.7) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($331.15), and RSI is 21.
read.zh: Alphabet 10月29日跳空大跌 12.6% 至 $283.82，10月30日再跌 1.4%，收于 $279.84，盘中区间 $276.92–283.14，成交量为均量的 2.1 倍。股价位于下行的 5 日（$305.2）、10 日（$319.0）、30 日（$337.3）、100 日（$345.5）和 200 日均线（$340.7）下方。MACD 自 10月16日起位于信号线下方且在零轴之下，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$331.15），RSI 为 21。

read.en: The gap broke all three written supports, $321.3–324.5, $316.6–319.4 and $314.9, now resistance. Resistance is $283.1–288.3 (Oct 30 and Oct 29 highs), then $294.1–296.3 (Mar 9 and Feb 17 lows) and $314.9–316.6 (bottom of the gap). Support is $275.2–276.9 (Nov 7, 2025 and Oct 30 lows), then $270.7–272.1 (52-week low, Mar 30 low) and $257.3. A close above $288.3 would target $294–296; below $270.7, $257.

r.en: Bottom of the Oct 29 gap: Jul 23 low $314.9; Oct 26 low $316.6
